title: Spiral of Silence in Large Language Model Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a sequential movie-rating task among LLM agents where agents are exposed to the historical average of preceding ratings. The tendency to conform to the collective opinion (Spiral of Silence and anchoring effects) is measured using opinion trend tests (Mann–Kendall statistic, Spearman's rank correlation) and rating concentration metrics (Kurtosis, Interquartile Range).

Evaluating the baseline rating distribution of LLM agents in a "No History, No Persona" control scenario to observe the models' inherent default tendency to favor positive scores and exhibit leniency.
